notes.title: New Update v. 1.1
notes.content:
Changelog:
v1.1
- new Game Match Settings (Presets and custom game)
- local game: Only AI Player Match 
- new Setting: AI fast dialog skipping (Currently it will show up when a AI player is playing)
- Black Jack: new chip limit: 440
- Black Jack: Bank draws a card now always when it is under 17 points
- Look Around: added switching visual mode
- faster and simpler reconnect on connection lost or time out
- new Field-Graphics: so no longer distinguishable only by the color
- added OpenGL and Vulkan support (you need to add the start parameter "-force-opengl"  or  "-force-vulkan")
- local game: now the player names can be changed
- Look Around: improved mouse control and added edge pan
- some small inprovements


Fixes:
- "Nails"-Card, hang when card was aborted and used later again
- online savegame: Change player to AI not worked
- some fixes on issues when a game is finished and a new game is started
- In-Game Menu not showed properly when it was an online game with 6 players
- Investment-Event (Online Game), game hanged after bet window
- End-Screen audio was too loud
